sources.title: Abstract arXiv:2110.03105v4 [cs.AI] 9 Jul 2024
sources.snippet: Abstract Humans have the capacity to question what we see and to recognize when our vision is unreli-able (e.g., when we realize that we are experienc-ing a visual illusion). Inspired by this capacity, we present MetaCOG: a hierarchical probabilistic model that can be attached to a neural object detec-tor to monitor its outputs and determine their relia-bility.
